criteria.note: Ran the CLI against a mock server on an ephemeral port: pass.journey.json exits 0, fail.journey.json exits 1 naming all three violations. run(journey, caller=my_callable) uses my injected caller with no network (captured call list == expected). base_url arg and BASE_URL env var both override the journey base_url (verified BASE_URL redirected a fixture whose journey base_url points at a dead :8080). A 4xx/5xx is a returned assertable status (a contract expecting [404]/[500] passes; expecting [200] against a 500 fails naming status), not an uncaught crash. A non-JSON body raises a ValueError surfaced as a named request-error violation (not a silent empty body); an empty body parses to None. A dead endpoint fails loud (request error, exit 1), never a silent pass. urllib/stdlib only.

76 adversarial check_contract/resolve_path/run assertions all held. Type safety: integer and number both reject Python bool True/False; each of string/number/integer/boolean/array/object/null matches its own kind and rejects the others (number correctly also accepts an int); violations name the field and the observed type. Present-vs-null: a field set to null is PRESENT and satisfies type null but fails a non-null type with a 'expected type ... got ...' message (not 'absent'); an absent field reports 'absent'. Dotted paths: nested object keys and list-integer segments resolve present/absent; out-of-range and non-int list segments and descent into a scalar all report absent. Asserts-nothing (no expect_status/required/forbidden, and empty status list) is a journey error that fails loud, both via check_contract and via run() (passed False). Forbidden: present (including present-but-null and nested) fails, absent passes.

Both fixtures ship under fixtures/ with a stdlib http.server mock. I fetched the raw payloads myself: /order/1 returns amount as a number, currency present, no internal_debug; /order/broken returns amount as the string "42.50", drops currency, and leaks internal_debug. So grading is real, not hardcoded. pass.journey.json against the conforming resource exits 0; fail.journey.json against the broken resource exits 1 naming amount-wrong-type, currency-absent, and forbidden internal_debug. Rubber-stamp test: tampering a /tmp copy of the pass fixture to require a nonexistent field and to re-type amount as string made the runner exit 1 naming both, against the same conforming resource. Determinism: 5 consecutive fail-fixture runs each exit 1 with an identical violation signature.

python3 scripts/selftest.py => 275 passed, 0 failed (matches the manifest count; prior cases intact). The integration block exercises check_contract for every outcome and drives run() over both shipped fixtures against an in-process mock on an ephemeral daemon-thread port. ./scripts/verify.sh => GATE: GREEN (3c5c8d05615c660b11d1481fa7d6e93c18879eea), catalog 5 run / 18 n-a / 0 waived / 0 undeclared.

Case-insensitive grep of the runner, README, wrapper, mock server, and both fixtures for bcengi/dejitech/travelpass/workpass/agentpass/coreconnect/onesim/mvne/dmitry/tripdesk/daybook/stripe/hubspot/ava returned zero matches. No em-dash (U+2014), en-dash (U+2013), or double-hyphen '--' in the added content. Both capabilities.yaml files carry integration_contract_runner with status: reference (not mechanical) and are byte-identical (sha256 eb3241343ba724df... on both). verify.sh docs-hygiene, secret, lint, and template-sync gates all pass.

findings.text: A journey with a base_url/caller but an EMPTY interactions list passes vacuously (run() returns passed True, exit 0). The 'a check that asserts nothing is not proof' rule is enforced per-interaction exactly as AC2 specifies, but not at the whole-journey level, so a zero-interaction journey is a vacuous green. No AC requires a zero-interaction journey to be an error, so this is a minor robustness gap, not a defect against the spec.

Proportionality: the 296-line runner is justified by its surface, not bloated. Roughly 77 lines are the module docstring/journey-format documentation appropriate for a drop-in reference; the remaining logic (bool-safe type system, dotted-path resolver with list indexing and present-vs-null distinction, transport with 4xx/5xx-returned and non-JSON-error handling, the pure contract checker, the seam-based runner, and the CLI) is cohesive with no dead code or redundant branches. do_request's Content-Type auto-set and 'replace' decoding are reasonable defaults for a reference.

summary: I confirmed HEAD == 3c5c8d0, recomputed the manifest proof_digest (sha256:23265d03a2cab081, exact match), and reran everything independently rather than trusting the manifest. selftest.py = 275 passed / 0 failed; verify.sh = GATE GREEN bound to 3c5c8d0; the wrapper self-test passed. I stood up the stdlib mock on ephemeral ports and drove the runner over both fixtures via the CLI (pass=exit 0, fail=exit 1 naming amount-wrong-type, currency-absent, and forbidden internal_debug), and verified the mock genuinely returns divergent conforming vs violating payloads. Adversarially, 76+ direct calls to check_contract/resolve_path/run held: bool is rejected by integer and number, every JSON type matches its own kind and rejects others, present-but-null is distinguished from absent (null satisfies null but fails a non-null type as a TYPE mismatch, not 'absent'), dotted object/list-index paths resolve present/absent, forbidden present (incl. nested and null) fails while absent passes, and an interaction that asserts nothing is a loud journey error. The transport is a real seam: an injected caller is used with no network, base_url arg and BASE_URL env both override, 4xx/5xx are assertable statuses (not crashes), a non-JSON body is a named error, and a dead endpoint fails loud. A tampered pass-fixture correctly flipped to exit 1, and the fail fixture is deterministic across 5 runs. AC5 hygiene is clean: zero company/product names, no em/en dash or '--', and the two capabilities.yaml files are byte-identical (sha256 eb3241343ba724df) with status: reference. All five ACs are confirmed. Two non-defect notes (a zero-interaction journey passes vacuously; line count is proportionate) yield pass_with_notes.
